title: Product Size Reference Photo to Show Scale | AIVideosUGC
description: Put your product next to a familiar object so shoppers can judge its size at a glance. AI scale photos for listings and ads, from one photo.
h1: Product Size Reference Photo Next to Objects Shoppers Know
lead: Shoppers need a quick sense of scale, not another dimension table. Put your product beside a familiar object in one clear square image.

steps.d: Keep the whole item in frame, with no clipped handle, sole or corner. The full outline is the size cue.
Name one familiar object such as a palm, carry-on or notebook. The generated proportion is a visual cue; compare it with measured dimensions.
Download the image and check the comparison looks natural. Add the real length, width, height or capacity in your listing text.

faq.q: Is the size in the photo exact?
faq.a: No. It is a visual guide, and generated scale can be slightly off. Put the real length, width, height or capacity in the listing text.

faq.q: Which object gives a useful size cue?
faq.a: Choose one familiar, unbranded object such as a hand, notebook, carry-on or common bottle. Pick the object shoppers will recognize fastest for your product.

faq.q: Should each image use one reference object?
faq.a: Yes. One clear reference object keeps the comparison easy to read. Use a separate image when you need a different cue.
Put exact length, width, height and capacity in your listing text or dimension table. Keep the reference photo as the quick visual guide beside those facts.

faq.q: Can I use this as an Amazon listing image?
faq.a: Yes. A scale comparison can be one of the extra images in an Amazon gallery when it shows the real item.

faq.q: Where can I use a size reference photo?
faq.a: Use the square image in a product page, Amazon or Shopify gallery, feed post or carousel beside exact dimensions.

faq.q: Can I make several size scenes from one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse one clear product photo to try another familiar cue or setting. Compare each result with your measured dimensions before posting.

faq.q: Do I need props or a studio?
faq.a: No. The reference object and setting are generated from your product photo, and downloads have no watermark.

faq.q: Can shoppers judge fit from the image?
faq.a: They can orient themselves faster, but the listing still needs exact measurements for a purchase decision.

faq.q: What does a size reference photo cost?
faq.a: Each product size reference photo costs 24 credits, shown before the job starts.

steps.prompt: Show the uploaded tote beside a notebook on a bench so its scale is easy to judge.
